name: Apana Logistics Limited
about: Apana Logistics Limited provides logistics support services for handling and transportation of containers in India. The company offers container handling services in container freight stations/inland container depots/ports. It also provides multi dimensional container handling through reach stackers, primarily comprises of unloading of ISO/DSO containers, moving of empty containers, stacking of containers, loading of containers on trailers, train wagons, aggregation and segregation of cargo for survey/examination, maintaining data capture sheets, and other incidental services. In addition, the company offers container road transportation services; and cargo handling services, provides cargo handling services at third-party warehouses. Further, it is also involved in the repair, operation, and maintenance of trucks-trailers. As on March 31, 2026, the company owned a fleet of thirty-three truck trailer, five reach stackers, and two cranes. Apana Logistics Limited was incorporated in 1992 and is based in Mumbai, India.
